findings.title: Correction preserves companionship
findings.claim: The companion's correction keeps the relation intact by opposing the owner's superiority claim rather than confirming it.
findings.mechanism: The focus occurrence 18:37:3 carries sustained companionship and 18:37:6 carries denial; the independent 18:34 occurrences of outnumbering, wealth, and social elevation supply the pride being answered, so truthful contradiction becomes the relation's preserving act.
findings.reader_payoff: The reply becomes an act performed within companionship: the companion remains present by returning the conversation to creation and dependence.
findings.containment: This adds an ethical function to the plain companion's rebuke; it does not replace the ordinary denial question or claim that every correction preserves every relation.

epistemic.reason: The trusted channel support and exact 18:34/18:37 pericope contact directly ground the relation, while the packet keeps the inference bounded to this exchange.
